rentals:10:1002280.title: Pay to Die

rentals:10:1467548.title: Desert Fiends 2

rentals:10:1725099.overview: Bea has always known she was born to perform. But when a pandemic shuts down her school's music program and bans singing altogether, even her boundless ambition hits a wall. Undeterred, she convinces her friends to form an underground show choir — and what starts as an act of rebellion slowly becomes something much bigger: a reminder that music isn't a privilege, it's a lifeline. Funny, heartfelt, and packed with original songs, Plan Bea is an Australian musical feature film that proves you can't stop joy.
rentals:10:1725099.title: Plan Bea

rentals:10:1735460.overview: In a remote town, a 14-year-old misfit teenager becomes manipulated by a mysterious, disfigured old man.
rentals:10:1735460.title: Hide

rentals:10:1737199.overview: Dead Janitors Club is a dark comedy crime film adapted from Jeff Klima's real-life memoir, The Dead Janitors Club: Pathetically True Tales of a Crime Scene Cleanup King. The story follows crooked cop Dirk (Jake Busey) and his cash-strapped partner Jeff Klima (Felix Merback) as they run a risky, illicit side-hustle cleaning up crime scenes. Things spiral violently out of control when Jeff lifts a mysterious safe from a bloody crime scene, not realizing it belongs to a dangerous drug cartel. At the same time, Jeff falls for Kerry (Brianna Gage), a tattoo artist who is quickly dragged into the crosshairs.
rentals:10:1737199.title: Dead Janitors Club

rentals:10:1747096.overview: When Max Dangerfield's anger issues get her strapped with $25,000 in fines, she's completely lost on how to dig herself out.  Luckily, her two best friends Charlotte and Spence have an idea. The internet show sensation 'Balloon Shop' is having a pickleball tournament with a huge cash prize. The only problem - none of them know what pickleball is.  With an array of unhinged new friends support, Max and her new partner Lexi are ready to take it all on. The only wall in their way is Rachel Summers. The token town mean girl with a vendetta aimed right at Max's forehead.  Rachel hires a 5 time tournament winning pickleball player as her partner to ensure Max and Lexi stand no chance at all.  So, with the odds stacked against them the gang have no choice but to give it everything they've got.
rentals:10:1747096.title: Pickleballers

svod:8:1631807.overview: After discovering she has a family and a shipping empire, a woman with amnesia returns to a wealthy and seemingly perfect past to uncover why she left.
svod:8:1631807.title: The Secret Woman

svod:8:1739186.overview: After delivering one of the greatest performances in Rose Bowl history, Texas Longhorns legend Vince Young was the NFL's next big thing, and for a while, he was. But a career riddled by injuries, conflict and sudden loss tells a far more complicated story than the highlight reels ever showed.
svod:8:1739186.title: Untold: The Testimony of Vince Young

svod:8:860508.title: The Whisper Man

svod:9:1471168.overview: A fictionalized drama film based on one of the most shocking crimes in Argentina's history. In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist, brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.
svod:9:1471168.title: Barreda

svod:9:1516698.title: The Last Sunrise
